paper_title: A Controllable Examination for Long-Context Language Models
caption: The bar chart of performance by different attributes on the 2-retrieval task. For simplicity, we abbreviate the names of all instruct models.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of four different language models—Qwen2.5-7b-1M, Internlm3-8b, ProLong-8b, and Qwen2.5-7b—on a multi-retrieval task with n=2, broken down by five distinct attributes: city (teal), hobby (orange), university (blue), major (purple), and birthday (green). The horizontal axis lists the four models in order from left to right, while the vertical axis represents accuracy, scaled from 0 to 100 in increments of 20. For each model, five bars are grouped together, each corresponding to one of the five attributes, with colors consistently representing the same attribute across all model groups. The Qwen2.5-7b-1M model shows high accuracy across all attributes, with values approximately 90 for city, 85 for hobby, 85 for university, 90 for major, and 85 for birthday. Internlm3-8b exhibits moderate performance, with accuracy around 70 for city, 80 for hobby, 55 for university, 65 for major, and 90 for birthday. ProLong-8b shows similar trends, with accuracy around 70 for city, 80 for hobby, 60 for university, 30 for major, and 85 for birthday. In contrast, Qwen2.5-7b performs significantly worse, with accuracy near 5 for city, 5 for hobby, 5 for university, 5 for major, and 15 for birthday. The bars are not sorted by height within each group, and there is no visual emphasis such as shading or annotation on any specific bar. The chart uses a standard linear scale and does not include error bars or confidence intervals.
